title: Pompa Air Si Mbah
subject: a man in a Bekasi kontrakan whose second-hand water pump dies every morning right when he is soaped up in the shower, so he runs out in a towel to prime it with a bucket, talks to it like an old grandfather, and his wife times him from the kitchen
caption: Indonesian rockabilly, 50s revival with a Bali-scene edge. Hollow-body electric guitar with slapback echo playing twangy double-stop licks, slapped upright bass clicking on every beat, brushed snare and kick shuffle, honky-tonk piano rolls in the breaks. Dry 50s room sound with tape slapback, live-band energy. Male mid-high vocal with playful hiccups, clearly sung melody, gang shouts on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 172 BPM, E major. Mood of a slapstick morning chase. No trap drums, no autotune, no synths, no modern pop-punk power chords, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - slapback guitar lick, slapped bass]
[Verse 1]
Sabun di kepala, busa di mata
Air di keran tiba-tiba nggak ada
Pakai handuk, lari ke belakang
Mbah Pompa diam, ngambek sekarang
[Pre-Chorus]
Satu ember, tuang pelan
Jangan mogok waktu aku mandi
[Chorus]
Ayo, Mbah, bangun dong, Mbah
Aku masih penuh busa
Istriku pegang jam dapur
Rekor kemarin dua menit lima
[Verse 2]
Kuketuk tutupnya tiga kali
Kubisikkan lagu dangdut tadi pagi
Dia batuk, dia bergetar
Air muncrat, handukku lepas, gempar
[Chorus]
Ayo, Mbah, bangun dong, Mbah
Aku masih penuh busa
Istriku tepuk tangan keras
Rekor baru satu menit saja
[Outro - piano roll, guitar ending]
Besok pagi, Mbah
Jangan mogok lagi, Mbah
